command: sudo CONDITIONS="downlink both-rtt50 downlink-long" REPEATS=3 SECONDS_PER_RUN=41 SYSTEMS="legacy v2-nofec v2-fec v2-nack v2-fec-nack" LOSSES="0 10 20 50 100" HARD_SYSTEMS="v2-fec v2-nack v2-fec-nack" HARD_LOSSES="0 20 50 100" HARD_DELAY_MS=25 LONG_LOSSES="10" LONG_SECONDS=300 LONG_REPEATS=1 RELAY_LOG=0 CHUNK_SECONDS=720 bench/run_b1.sh
link: veth pairs, MTU 1500, the server's veth towards the receiver with gso_max_segs 1

conditions.downlink: best case for recovery: nftables drops UDP packets at the receiver's prerouting hook, priority -500 (before defragmentation, so single IP fragments), server -> receiver only; NACKs and REGISTERs take an unimpaired path with a sub-millisecond round trip
conditions.both-rtt50: userspace relay (bench/lib/udp_impair.py) between the receiver and the server: independent drops per datagram in both directions and a fixed one-way delay each way (25 ms by default: +50 ms round trip); NACKs, retransmissions, parity and REGISTERs can be lost; v2 only (the relay works on whole datagrams)
conditions.downlink-long: the downlink condition for the 2024 version only, in long runs, for its dynamics as the receiver's IP reassembly queue fills

media: corpus frames 480x480 JPEG q85 at 15.625 fps (one per 1024-sample audio chunk, the legacy rate); 16 kHz mono PCM audio

relay.method: userspace UDP relay (bench/lib/udp_impair.py): independent drops per datagram and direction, fixed one-way delay, order kept
